scope: Standalone lossless GPU transfer codec: all 28 layers use our Dense or Rank256 predictor/rANS. Current rolling encoding is the reference. Separate fixed arms reuse one temporary INT8 feature matrix or partition 8K decoding into one, four or eight token chunks instead of two. They are not combined. Original complete packets, fitted coefficients, arithmetic, binary CDF search and BF16 words stay fixed. SplitZip and ExANS remain separate unchanged controls, not candidate components. 512-token graph execution and 8K borrowed-input direct execution are retained. The two documents are reused engineering evidence, not independent generalization. Link costs are calculated, not NIC/SSD, resident P or serving measurements.
